title: Holotron world template
description: The single documented contract for world_template.json. Emitted by world_agent, consumed verbatim by code_agent as window.TEMPLATE, and hand-enforced by scripts/check_template.mjs against the game's extracted state. NOTE: this file is documentation, not a library-validated schema (no JSON-Schema validator is available without adding a dependency); scripts/check_template.mjs is the executable enforcement. Keys marked optional may be absent; consumers must tolerate their absence.

x-runtime-state.description: CANONICAL runtime state contract. The game exposes window.worldState() as { seed, start, rooms: { "<slug>": { "name": <string>, "archetype": <archetype id from `archetypes`>, "exits": { "<dir>": "<slug>" }, "things": ["<slug>"] } } } and window.systemState(). scripts/check_template.mjs validates this state against the template: every room's `archetype` must name a declared archetype; the count of rooms per archetype must fall within that archetype's `count` bounds (unbounded archetypes are skipped); and the `start` room's archetype must be the `role:entry` archetype. Rooms reported are the active floor. If NO room declares an `archetype`, the check is treated as unexercised (not failed). Multi-floor: `down`/`up` are valid exit directions; each floor is generated once from hash(seed, depth), cached and mutated in place (mutations are a delta), and the Phase 2 check reads the pristine boot state (pre-mutation). The template is floor-agnostic — archetype `count` bounds describe one generated floor; per-floor escalation lives in the GDD, not here.

seed_default.description: Default generation seed, or null for random at boot.

test_seed.description: Pinned seed used by the Phase 2 checker. The game must honor this seed so the verified layout is reproducible.

archetypes.description: Room archetypes the generator may place; count bounds how many of each a floor may contain.

rules.description: Non-normative documentation of intended transitions between roles, e.g. "entry -> corridor*". The generator does not consume it and scripts/check_template.mjs does not enforce it.

required_things.description: Things every generated floor MUST place and make reachable from start.

required_encounters.description: Encounters that MUST exist and be reachable on the pinned test_seed (guarantees the systemic check has something to drive even if wave 2 ships truncated).

resources.description: Named player resources and their starting/burn parameters.

clocks.description: Player-facing clocks. `behavior` is OUR contract describing the game mechanic; it is NOT a Holonovel feature (the deployed manage_countdown has no clock_type and cannot count up).

npcs.description: The survivor roster. `disposition` uses the categorical scale; `numeric_range` maps it to the game's -2..+2 dial.

social_actions.description: Warm/cold action table. dread_delta is signed (negative = warm, lowers Dread).

encounter_roster.description: Creatures and obstacles the generator may place.
